question:
When is the latest patient's medical data recorded? This patient should have an abnormal level of lactate dehydrogenase.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: latest patient refers to ID with MAX('First Date'); abnormal level of lactate dehydrogenase refers to LDH > = 500;

arguments.sql:

FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
